The '''Large Scale Production Facilities''' was a industrial area in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Ganelon Shipyards]] and the [[VerveGen Corporation building|main building]] of the [[VerveGen Corporation]] were located in the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Large Scale Production Facilities appears as part of the Upper Industrial Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
